Review Gleap?

Reviewers describe Gleap as a flexible all-in-one support and feedback tool that is easy to use, polished, and backed by fast, helpful support. Users repeatedly highlight bug reporting, customer feedback collection, surveys, and the Kai chatbot, with one longtime customer saying Kai handles advanced support workflows better than Intercom’s Fin. Several also praise the steady pace of improvements and features like automatic screenshots, video capture, and knowledge base options. A founder from Crono similarly says it helps close the customer feedback loop quickly without slowing product work.
